general_information.Description: This course advances learners’ English proficiency for social, academic, and professional communication. The course develops mastery of complex grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation while deepening awareness of cultural and global issues. Students interpret authentic materials, analyze information from various sources, and express opinions confidently in discussions or debates. Writing tasks emphasize clarity, organization, and accuracy. Learners apply technology and AI tools for efficient, ethical learning, demonstrate professionalism in collaboration, and use self-assessment strategies to achieve lifelong learning and global competence.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible for doing all exercises, assignments, and labs given by the instructor in class or at home and submitting them on time - Use a laptop in class only for learning purposes - Access the course website for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.
general_information.Note: 1) On-going assessment: 50% 2) Final Examination (FE): 50% 3) Final Result: 100% 4) Completion Criteria: On-going assessment >0, each part of the final exam must be >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10,

description: This course advances learners’ English proficiency for social, academic, and professional communication. The course develops mastery of complex grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation while deepening awareness of cultural and global issues. Students interpret authentic materials, analyze information from various sources, and express opinions confidently in discussions or debates. Writing tasks emphasize clarity, organization, and accuracy. Learners apply technology and AI tools for efficient, ethical learning, demonstrate professionalism in collaboration, and use self-assessment strategies to achieve lifelong learning and global competence.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify and explain advanced English vocabulary, grammatical structures, and pronunciation patterns used in social, academic, and professional contexts.
Demonstrate understanding of cultural, social, and global topics through interpretation and discussion of authentic materials.
Comprehend main ideas, supporting details, and speaker attitudes in extended conversations, interviews, and discussions on familiar and abstract topics.
Maintain longer conversations and discussions, express opinions and reasons, describe experiences and plans in detail, and use connected speech with sufficient fluency and grammatical accuracy.
Analyze and synthesize information from articles, reports, and online sources; infer meaning, tone and writer’s purpose through critical reading strategies.
Produce connected and coherent paragraphs on familiar or abstract topics, demonstrating logical organization, appropriate vocabulary, and generally accurate grammar.
Apply information technology and artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance English learning efficiently, ethically, and responsibly.
Work independently and collaboratively with accountability, demonstrating respect, professionalism, and ethical behavior in communication and academic activities.

Develop and implement a personal learning plan using self-assessment and technology to monitor progress, reflect on performance, and improve English proficiency for lifelong learning and global communication.

assessments.Note: 1. Grammar - Vocabulary: Vocabulary: 20 questions + Grammar 20 questions; MCQ 4 options, gap filling, matching; 20 minutes 2. Reading: 21 questions; 3 texts - 300-450 words/text; MCQ 4 options, gap filling, matching; Level: B1+; Topic: 10 units in the textbook; 25 minutes 3. Listening: 21 questions; 3 audios; MCQ 4 options, gap filling, matching; Level: B1+; around 3 mins/audio; 2 times listening; 25 minutes 4. Writing: ~180-200 words; 2 paragraphs - one topic; type: opinion paragraph and informal email; 30 minutes 5. Speaking: in pairs; 10 mins per pair Part 1. Role-play (2 mins prep, 3-4 mins to speak) Students prepare for 2 minutes Perform the role-play for 3-4 minutes Part 2. Discussion Questions (2 mins per student) 5 discussion questions provided Teacher selects 1-2 questions to ask each student Questions may be shuffled Completion Criteria: - On-going assessment >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10 - Each part of the final exam must be >0. Do not allow the use of any document/information in any form in the exam room
